mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payroll growth exceeding 150,000 persons signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 3-year rolling walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong household demand, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of instances, or the interaction term has a negative or insignificant coefficient in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above its 12-month moving average indicates strengthening real economic output, which enhances corporate profitability and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% per annum signals a tightening monetary policy regime, which increases discount rates on future equity cash flows and reduces risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the signal has a Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in non-farm payroll growth signals labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to produce negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of instances, or the interaction term is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in residential construction starts below 800,000 units signals weakening housing demand, which reduces construction-related corporate revenues and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 800k, or the signal has a Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below its 12-month moving average indicates a contraction in real output, which signals weakening corporate activity and reduced earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the signal fails to show a significant negative Rank IC in 3-year rolling walk-forward tests.
